## Offer.getApr() method

Converts this offer's tick into a WAD simple annual percentage rate at a timestamp.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getApr(timestamp: BigIntish): bigint;
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

timestamp


</td><td>

[BigIntish](./morpho-ts.bigintish.md)


</td><td>

Timestamp at which the APR is calculated.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

bigint

WAD simple APR rounded up.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when market maturity, `timestamp`<!-- -->, or `tick` is negative.

`TickOutOfRangeError` when `tick` exceeds `MAX_TICK`<!-- -->.

`DivisionByZeroError` when the tick price is zero or `timestamp` is at or after maturity.

## Example


```ts
import { Offer } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const offer = Offer.create({
  market: {
    loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000006000",
    collateralParams: [
      {
        token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000007000",
        lltv: 770000000000000000n,
        liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
        oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000008000",
      },
    ],
    maturity: 54_000n,
    rcfThreshold: 0n,
    enterGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    liquidatorGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  },
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009000",
  tick: 5_000n,
  expiry: 3_600n,
  ratifier: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000004000",
  maxUnits: 100n,
});
const apr = offer.getApr(1_000n);
console.log(apr);
```
